Existing current facts about entities this note mentions:
- memory_id "1000351" [decision]: The product catalog will keep image metadata in a separate table, because the joined writes were locking product updates for seconds at a time.  (about: product catalog)
- memory_id "1000339": The product catalog calls the image resizer for thumbnails, so the image resizer is a hard dependency of the product catalog.  (about: product catalog, image resizer)
- memory_id "1000313": Tomasz has the Atlas pager this cycle as of 2025-04-03, replacing Priya Raman.  (about: Atlas team, Priya Raman, Tomasz)
- memory_id "1000296": The Dune team observed that the notification service's memory use grew steadily for a week after the cache change.  (about: Dune team, cache change, notification service)
- memory_id "1000288": The Dune team owns the reports pipeline as of 2025-03-20.  (about: Dune team, reports pipeline)
- memory_id "1000281" [decision]: The Ember team owns the image resizer as of 2025-03-20.  (about: Ember team, image resizer)
- memory_id "1000278" [constraint]: The product catalog can be released on Mondays to Thursdays between 09:00 and 17:00 UTC; anything else needs an exception.  (about: product catalog)
- memory_id "1000246": As of 2025-03-03, the pager for webhooks rings the Ember team instead of the Boreal team.  (about: Boreal team, webhook dispatcher, Ember team)
- memory_id "1000241": Yuki Tanaka has the Cinder pager for the cycle starting 2025-02-27, taking over from Diego.  (about: Yuki Tanaka, Cinder, Diego)
- memory_id "1000236": Boreal noticed the ledger service's memory growth and pinged the owners on 2025-02-21.  (about: Boreal team, ledger service)
- memory_id "1000232": The ledger service's memory use grew steadily for a week after the cache change.  (about: ledger service, cache change)
- memory_id "1000224" [decision]: As of 2025-02-21, the notifier will retry failed pushes three times with exponential backoff.  (about: notifier)
- memory_id "1000175": The root cause of INC-2025-004 was a consumer offset stuck after a broker restart.  (about: INC-2025-004)
- memory_id "1000163" [constraint]: The ledger service must stay on Postgres 14 until the partitioning work finishes.  (about: ledger service, Postgres 14, partitioning work)
- memory_id "1000158": The indexer depends on the product catalog for product documents.  (about: product catalog, indexer)
- memory_id "1000118": The indexer is owned by Cinder.  (about: Cinder, indexer)
- memory_id "1000112": Cinder owns the product catalog.  (about: Cinder, product catalog)
- memory_id "1000085": Diego is on call for Cinder to start the year.  (about: Cinder, Diego)
- memory_id "1000026": Diego is on Cinder.  (about: Cinder, Diego)
- memory_id "1000021": Yuki Tanaka is on Cinder.  (about: Yuki Tanaka, Cinder)
Existing entity names: product catalog, image resizer, Atlas team, Priya Raman, Tomasz, Dune team, cache change, notification service, reports pipeline, Ember team, Boreal team, webhook dispatcher, Yuki Tanaka, Cinder, Diego, ledger service, notifier, INC-2025-004, Postgres 14, partitioning work, indexer
